direction.situation: Colombo roadside in light rain, just after Kasun has returned Anudi's phone; a warm, curious exchange has begun and this clip continues as she registers him and then her father interrupts.
direction.people: Anudi (on screen): standing left, cream blouse and teal skirt, holding the phone in her right hand, umbrella on her left arm; she enters the clip grateful and receptive, then subdued when the call arrives. Kasun (off-screen, implied): his small food three-wheeler sits in the right background; his presence is felt but he is not in the frame.

flow.text: Anudi holds the phone low in her right hand, eyes on the right where Kasun was; a slight, genuine smile stays on her lips. Her left arm supports the umbrella and handbag, relaxed.
Her appreciation settles—eyebrows lift a fraction, the smile softens into an attentive look toward the three-wheeler in the background; she absorbs the modesty of his small business.
The phone suddenly rings in her right hand. She lifts it and angles the screen toward herself so the caller display is clearly readable in the foreground; her gaze drops from the right to the phone.
The caller ID shows her father; Anudi's smile pauses and drains slowly from her face. She holds the phone steady, lips closed, eyes fixed on the screen, a quiet change moving through her expression.

direction.camera: Close-up (CU) from a slightly three-quarter road-side angle, Anudi upper-left with the phone screen foreground-right; a locked-off 50mm on sticks.
direction.sound: Light rain on umbrellas and distant traffic; an incoming phone ring; no music.
